page_found_items.listing_name: USDA - Short Ribs Bone-In - 500g/pack
page_found_items.overview_text: Beef short ribs bone-in are a flavorful and tender cut of meat taken from the lower portion of the rib cage. These ribs contain both meat and bone, offering a rich and hearty taste. When slow-cooked or braised, the meat becomes succulent and falls off the bone, creating a melt-in-your-mouth texture. They are often marbled with fat, which adds to the depth of flavor during cooking. Beef short ribs bone-in are a popular choice for dishes that require long, slow cooking methods to unlock their full potential.
